note: Camping here is at two spots MDC marks for primitive camping: this one at the south-west corner off East 330th Street, a gravel lot at the end of a short gravel lane beside a fishing pond, and one off Route CC at East 320th Place. No pads, tables or toilets, and vehicles must stay on the gravel. Open fires only in designated areas. Prairie, crop fields and timber with many small ponds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC designates both spots (map Primitive Camping symbols, a GIS camping point at each); each is a gravel lot or lane edge with nothing built - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule. Pin is the better of the two (lot by the pond). Phone matches. No split.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the brochure says 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map' and 'Motor vehicles are restricted to roadways and parking areas'. The 04/25 map shows two Primitive Camping symbols: one at the south-west corner beside a Parking Lot symbol and pond 12, one beside Route CC at E 320 PL between two Parking Lot symbols. GIS layer 27 has a point at each: 517 at 40.23673,-93.82731 and 354 at 40.24945,-93.80280. On imagery the south-west spot is a gravel lot about 30 x 12 m at the end of a 130 m curved gravel lane off East 330th Street, 25 m from a pond about 110 m across; the GIS point is in open grass 100 m north of the lot. The Route CC spot's GIS point is in a clump of cedars on the north side of the gravel lane (E 320 PL) 90 m west of Route CC, with a small gravel lot (GIS lot 36) 160 m south-east across the highway; nothing is built at either. Neither is a built camp; the south-west lot is the more usable.
PIN (optional move): stored 40.23673,-93.82731 is the GIS point in grass; the gravel lot a rig would use is at about 40.23595,-93.82772 (100 m south).
BROCHURE RULE: 'No open fires, except in designated areas.' Put in the note.
NO SPLIT: the Route CC spot is 2.5 km away on its own road but is a cedar clump beside a lane and a single small lot. Nothing else in the database within 2 km of it.
WATER: the pond beside the lot is about 110 m across (roughly 2 acres) - a pond, so not waterfront stands.
ACCESS: gravel East 330th Street from paved Route CC; no posted limit or 4WD wording.
PHONE: stored 660-646-6122 matches the page's 'For more information call (660) 646-6122'.
No horse camp: the brochure allows horses on multi-use trails but the map marks no equestrian camp.
